name: Chargebee
shortInfo: Automates the lead-to-ledger workflow across user’s revenue stack
brief: Chargebee automates the lead-to-ledger workflow across user’s revenue stack. It is a recurring billing and subscription management tool that helps businesses streamline Revenue Operations. It integrates with the leading payment gateways like Stripe, Braintree, PayPal etc. to let its customers automate recurring payment collection along with invoicing, taxes, accounting, email notifications, SaaS Metrics and customer management.
about:
Chargebee is the subscription billing and revenue management platform that lets you solve for your today, and scale for your tomorrow.  
  
Learn more about [Chargebee API documentation.](https://www.chargebee.com/)
